$doc: Every token in the app (docs/SPEC.md 8.11). tools/tokens/compile.mjs compiles it into app/ui/src/styles/tokens.css, crates/wwav-tokens/src/generated.rs and engine/include/wwav_tokens.h. A value is a colour (#rrggbb or rgba(r, g, b, a)), a list of colours (a gradient's stops, top or centre first), a number, a number with a unit (px, ms or em), a cubic-bezier() curve, or a list of names. {light, dark} gives each appearance its own value; anything else is the same in both. Keys starting with $ are notes and checks, not tokens.

desk.$doc: Learn and the Console's chrome, Settings and every sheet (8.2). Light and dark are Learn's tokens with 8.2's five fixes, and two inks moved so they hold on every stop of their ground (see $contrast). A gel pill draws its stops top to bottom with a hard break at gelBreak: a plain gel's two as first, first, second, first; a blue gel's four as listed. A segment or chip draws a plain gel's two as a plain gradient.

lcd.$doc: The Now strip: Learn's olive LCD (2.2). Its dim text is darkened in light (8.2) and lightened in dark, so it holds on both stops.

sourceList.$doc: The library drawer and Learn's sidebar, with headings darkened (8.2).

screen.$doc: The Game Boy inside: every Console readout is a DMG screen, the same in light and dark (8.2, 5.2; MI-WWAV-OS theme.dart). Meters are DMG green to -6 dBFS, amber to -1, rec above.

night.$doc: Space and the expanded player, in both appearances (8.2; v3, v4). Seven ink opacities are the only hierarchy scale; royal blue has three uses and is never text.

stem.$doc: PRANA's stem colours, the same everywhere, in stem order (8.3). Every stem mark carries a ring in its register's ink; state is shape: muted is a stem-colour ring, soloed adds an outer ring, silent under a solo fills at 45% with a dashed ring, selected adds a notch.

heat.$doc: Learn's level colours (3.1). They fill tubes, pill borders and dots; the level word is ink.

label.$doc: The six colour labels, for sorting only (2.5).

key.$doc: A work's key colour (8.3, v4 keyColor.js): hue = ((pc * 7) mod 12) * 30 with A = 0, in hsl with the mode's saturation and lightness. An unknown key is night indigo in the minor look. The glow tone an orb's rim takes is the same hue and saturation at the glow lightness.

light.$doc: One light, from the upper left, as a fraction of the box (8.3, v3 WWAVLight.sun).

motion.$doc: Built on MI-WWAV-OS's 140 ms beat with v4's curves (8.6). Under Reduce Motion every move is a beat-long cross-fade. Nothing bounces.

radius.$doc: Corners (8.3). Gels are full pills; a sheet rounds only its lower corners.

type.$doc: Faces and sizes (8.4). Nothing is under 11; text read for more than a line is at least the reading size (8.9, open: 17 or 19).

prism.$doc: The Focus layout's look (docs/FOCUS.md): a prism instrument. At rest the app is white light, paper in light and ink in dark, and colour appears only where there is energy: a thin band for a space, a small field, a focus ring. Nothing is a gradient, a gloss or a shadow. ink, ink2 and ink3 hold on ground, raised and sunk; line is the only border, for a control that would otherwise be ambiguous; fill is the one filled button a screen has.

band.$doc: The spectrum: the four WWAV anchors a space's band of light is placed on or between, in order round the wheel. A band is a mark, never text and never a large fill, and it always sits beside the space's name. width is the band's thickness; rest is how much of its colour a band keeps when entropy is 0, and it reaches full colour at entropy 1 (heat scales it again, task by task).

readout.$doc: The readout: the device's character LCD, drawn dot by dot. A dark field in both appearances, the same everywhere, with every unlit dot faintly there. A character is a 5 by 8 cell of dots; cells are a dot apart.

radius.$doc: Corners are nearly square: a machined edge, not a pill.

type.$doc: One grotesk for words, one mono for numbers, times and the readout, and Hiragino Sans for Japanese (it follows the grotesk in the stack, so 第2課 is set in it). Both faces are bundled (app/ui/src/focus/fonts, SIL Open Font License). Numbers that line up are tabular.
type.title: 22px

motion.$doc: Instrument motion: a part settles with slight weight and stops, like a knob reaching a detent. Nothing bounces, and under Reduce Motion nothing moves. edgeRest is how long the cursor rests on the left edge before the tool list comes out; mapHold is how long the command key is held before the map shows.

$contrast.$doc: Every pair the spec measures (8.2, 8.3, 8.11, 7.18). role is body (7:1), secondary (4.5:1) or mark (a ring, fill or light that never carries text, so no bar). A pair is judged in light and dark on every colour of its ground: each stop of a gradient and each ground in a list. alpha lays the ink over the ground first. quoted is the ratio the spec gives, taken where the pair's ratio is lowest unless quotedOn names the stop the spec measured; quotedOn never narrows the bar.

pairs.why: Words on metal are labels; running text sits in a well.
8.11 measures deck metal on its middle stop; the bottom stop is 10.9:1.

8.11's #5D6975 is 4.6:1 on the middle stop but 3.6:1 on the bottom one, where a mixer strip carries M, S and its name (5.8). Darkened in lightness alone, same hue, until the bottom stop gives the spec's 4.6 (a question for the founder).
8.2: the dark gel's top stop goes from #6a6d71 (4.4:1) to #5e6165 (5.3:1).

8.2: blue gels take an ink label, 4.6:1 on the darkest stop. Learn's dark blue gel keeps its light middle stops, so no label holds 4.5:1 on it; the blue gel stays lit in both appearances (a question for the founder).
Too low for white text, so the highlight is a ring, a gel and a bar (8.2).
8.11's dark #8e9670 is 5.1:1 on the bottom stop but 4.3:1 on the top one. Lightened in lightness alone, same hue, until the top stop gives the spec's 5.1 (a question for the founder).
8.3 measures the middle stop; the bottom one is 1.2:1, so the ring carries even more.
Risk is said in words; the colour only marks them, and still reads as text.
